extracted.intended_audience: University of Minnesota research community (faculty, researchers, research staff, and research administrators)
extracted.subtask_description: A university office news page listing recent research-related announcements, awards, funding opportunities, and events relevant to UMN researchers and staff. The page highlights open calls, award criteria, deadlines, and program focuses.

rubrics_metrics.name: NSRI Seed Grants — focus on national security innovation
rubrics_metrics.description: These seed grants are focused on catalyzing innovative research that addresses high-priority national security challenges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: RIO and NSRI selected six projects to receive the first NSRI Seed Grants (totaling $570,000). The announcement frames award selection around catalyzing innovative research targeted at high-priority national security problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Technical Staff Award — recognition criteria and honorarium
rubrics_metrics.description: This award recognizes research staff for significant contributions and distinguished service to the UMN research community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The award recognizes 10 research staff members and includes a personal honorarium of $2,000 each. The notice solicits nominations/submissions and provides a deadline (submissions due June 1, 2026).

rubrics_metrics.name: Innovation Impact Case Award — impact outside academia
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes research that has led to significant impact outside of academia and has made a meaningful difference in communities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Open to all eligible UMN faculty and researchers. The announcement specifies the award's focus on demonstrable societal/community impact and lists a submission deadline (submissions due May 11, 2026).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Corporation for Science Advancement (RCSA) funding — support for innovative basic physical-sciences research
rubrics_metrics.description: RCSA funds programs that support innovative basic research in the physical sciences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page advertises an information session (June 2) to learn about RCSA funding programs and to meet the president/CEO, indicating that interested researchers should engage with program officers and attend informational events to learn eligibility and application expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emphasis on research integrity — Research Ethics Week
rubrics_metrics.description: Events and programming that focus on navigating the shifting landscape of research integrity and research ethics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The University convened Research Ethics Week (March 2–6) with broad participation (~1,800 attendees), underscoring institutional attention to research integrity as an evaluative and compliance priority for the research community.

rubrics_metrics.name: RIO oversight and tracking of key research metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: The Research and Innovation Office oversees the university's research enterprise and tracks key research metrics for the University.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: RIO's role includes monitoring metrics across the ~$1.3 billion annual research enterprise; while specific metrics are not listed on this page, tracking and reporting measurable research indicators is presented as an institutional function.
